menu.balance: Each wallet's total in USD and its top holdings
menu.positions: Each position: amount, value, average cost and P&L
menu.orders: Active auto orders with their triggers and fills
menu.cancel: Cancel an action that waits for your confirmation
menu.rescue: Open the rescue card: everything in the agent wallets goes to your rescue address
menu.paper: Switch the agent back to paper mode
menu.agents: Your agents, and the one this chat talks to
menu.use: Pick the agent this chat talks to, by its name
menu.status: binference's state, its agents, freezes and health
menu.spend: Model spend today and this month against the budget
menu.ai: The agent's models, with buttons to pick another
menu.clear: Start a new chat with the agent
menu.lang: The language binference uses with you
help.heading: These commands answer at once, without your agent's model:
agent.none: binference has no agent yet. Run `binference init` on the machine to make one.
agent.several: binference has {count, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}}: {agents}. Pick the one this chat talks to with /use and its name; /agents lists them.
balance.more: {count, plural, one {and # more holding} other {and # more holdings}}; /positions lists every one
balance.empty: No agent wallet holds anything yet.
positions.section: {mode, select, paper {🧪 Paper positions} other {🔴 Live positions}}
orders.item: {kind, select, limit {Limit order} takeProfit {Take-profit} stopLoss {Stop-loss} trailing {Trailing stop} dca {DCA} copy {Copy trade} other {Auto order}} · {side, select, buy {buy} other {sell}} {token} · {trigger} · {fills, plural, one {# fill} other {# fills}} · ends {expiry}
orders.price: {direction, select, above {at or above {price}} below {at or below {price}} other {at {price}}}
cancel.heading: {count, plural, one {# action waits for your confirmation. Tap Cancel on it to stop it.} other {# actions wait for your confirmation. Tap Cancel on the ones to stop.}}
cancel.none: Nothing waits for your confirmation, so there is nothing to cancel.
freeze.done: 🔴 Every agent is frozen since {when}, and every agent made until an unfreeze starts frozen. Their open cards and unsigned actions are cancelled; a transaction already sent finishes. Unfreeze in the CLI, the console or the Mini App.
rescue.waiting: The rescue card waits for your tap. Check the rescue address on it, then tap Confirm.
rescue.underWay: A rescue is under way: {state, select, awaiting_confirmation {waiting for your confirmation} confirmed {confirmed} executing {sending} included {sent, waiting to be final} finalized {final, being recorded} other {{state}}}.
rescue.ended: The rescue ended. Use /rescue again to move what is left.
paper.done: 🧪 {name} is in paper mode now: its trades fill on paper and nothing is sent on chain. Going live needs `binference live` on the machine.
console.open: Tap the button to open the console inside Telegram.
console.noAddress: The console opens inside Telegram only from an HTTPS address, and binference has none yet. Publish binference's port over HTTPS, for example with Tailscale serve, then set remote.publicUrl in config.json5 to that address, such as https://my-machine.my-tailnet.ts.net, and restart binference.
status.summary: binference {version} is {state, select, ready {running} starting {starting} locked {running but locked} other {{state}}}.
status.locked: 🔴 Locked: binference signs nothing until you run `binference unlock` on the machine.
status.installFrozen: 🔴 Every agent is frozen since {when}, and every agent made until an unfreeze starts frozen.
status.noRescueAddress: ⚠️ No rescue address is set. Run `binference rescue set` on the machine with your own wallet's address.
status.pendingRescueAddress: ⚠️ The rescue address changes to {address} at {when}. Not you? Run `binference rescue cancel` on the machine.
status.healthy: Health: {count, plural, =0 {no signals reported} one {the # signal is fine} other {all # signals are fine}}.
status.unhealthy: ⚠️ Health: {fail, plural, one {# signal failing} other {# signals failing}}, {warn, plural, one {# needs a look} other {# need a look}}. Run `binference health` on the machine.
limits.heading: Limits of {agent} in effect now:
limits.pendingHeading: These looser limits apply at {when}. Not you? Run `binference limit cancel` on the machine.
limits.tapToHalve: Each button halves its limit at once; a second tap halves it again. Nothing here loosens a limit.
limits.halve: {limit, select, perTradeUsdMicros {Halve the per-trade cap} rollingDayUsdMicros {Halve the 24-hour cap} slippageRegistryBps {Halve the slippage limit on verified tokens} slippageOtherBps {Halve the slippage limit on other tokens} other {Halve the limit}}
limits.lowest: {name} is {value} already, the lowest it goes.
spend.today: {agent}: {spent} of today's {budget} model budget spent, {left} left
spend.paused: Chat is paused until {when}; orders keep running.
spend.none: binference has no agent yet, so nothing is spent on models.
lang.current: binference uses {locale, select, zh {Chinese} other {English}} with you. Tap a language to switch; binference applies it at once.
lang.switched: binference uses {locale, select, zh {Chinese} other {English}} with you now.
agents.heading: Your agents:
agents.item: {name} · {mode}{frozen, select, yes { · frozen since {when}} other {}}{chat, select, yes { · this chat talks to it} other {}}
agents.useHint: /use and an agent's name picks the agent this chat talks to.
use.how: Name the agent this chat should talk to after /use, such as /use {first}. Your agents: {agents}.
use.unknown: No agent is named {name}. Your agents: {agents}.
use.done: This chat talks to {name} now. Its answers start with its name while you have more than one agent.
clear.done: A new chat has started. The agent forgets this conversation; its notes and files stay.
schedules.none: No scheduled turn is set yet.
schedules.heading: Scheduled turns:
ai.tapToPick: Tap a model to use it as the main model from the next message on. A model you pick stays, with no fallback; tap the configured main model to bring its fallbacks back.
ai.noModels: No model is set in config.json5. Set models.main on the machine, then try /ai again.
ai.gone: That model is no longer in config.json5. Send /ai for the models it has now.
ai.set: The main model is {model} from the next message on.
